name: io.github.Madnands5/owl24-mcp
description: MCP server for owl24 - gives coding agents direct access to your production error queue.

environmentVariables.name: OWL24_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your owl24 project API key, from that project's page on the owl24 dashboard. Agent Access must be enabled for the project first.

environmentVariables.name: OWL24_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the API base URL, for local or self-hosted testing only. Production customers never need to set this.
